steps.note: Tower drawing (CADCraft, no print standard): strip every hidden-data category (its metadata is only CADCraft's Title/Creator/Producer), then set the four fields and write a compressed copy.

Wall chart (DesignCraft PDF/X-4): remove every hidden-data category EXCEPT metadata. Its metadata is what makes it PDF/X-4 (GTS_PDFXVersion, the XMP with pdfxid, Trapped, dates), so a metadata strip would break the standard. Set the four fields (PdfCraft mirrors them into the XMP) and write a compressed copy: the output intent's FOGRA39 profile is stored uncompressed.
